stateMachine:
stateDiagram-v2
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallRequested[waitElapsed=false] → effects=[PERMIT]
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallRequested[waitElapsed=true] → effects=[PERMIT]
    CLOSED --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=true] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    CLOSED --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=true] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=false] → effects=[RESET_METRICS]
    HALF_OPEN --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=false] → effects=[RESET_METRICS]
    HALF_OPEN --> HALF_OPEN: CallRequested[waitElapsed=false] → effects=[PERMIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> HALF_OPEN: CallRequested[waitElapsed=true] → effects=[PERMIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=true] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=true] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=false] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=true] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=false] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    HALF_OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=true] → effects=[START_WAIT]
    OPEN --> HALF_OPEN: CallRequested[waitElapsed=true] → effects=[RESET_METRICS, PERMIT]
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=true] (Unchanged)
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=true] (Unchanged)
    CLOSED --> CLOSED: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallRequested[waitElapsed=false] (Rejected)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=true] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=false, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=true] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=false, thresholdExceeded=true] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=false] (Unchanged)
    OPEN --> OPEN: CallCompleted[failed=true, windowComplete=true, thresholdExceeded=true] (Unchanged)
